conversationalSummary.text: Tomorrow is probably one to skip. Meio da Baia at Afternoon — 16:00 looks like the least-bad option, but not really something worth chasing. best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 114 kJ, 8 s period, very consistent 80/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for afternoon — 16:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
